A system that has worked since 2009, but is held together by hand.

Numbering is digital, while filing, approvals and the procurement lifecycle still depend on people moving files between the intranet, Excel, PDF, email and SAP.

The opportunity is not to replace what works. It is to connect every step, file and decision around it, and to put that work on a platform VSL ME already owns: E5 and Copilot licences for its users.

Source: BEMEA discovery, October 202602
The guiding principle

Start small. Prove it. Then climb one step at a time.

Each phase delivers something usable on its own and makes the next one cheaper. VSL ME builds more of each step itself, and BEMEA is called on only for specialist work.

PHASE 0

Mobilise

Discovery, Test & Prod sites, access decisions

PHASE 1

Replace

Like-for-like on SharePoint + Power Apps. Manual filing gone.

Built by BEMEA

Automate

Teams/Outlook approvals, escalations, AI-extracted metadata, reporting.

BEMEA builds, VSL co-builds
PHASE 3

Secure & Segment

Department sites, role-based access, labels, retention, oversharing controls.

Joint with head office IT
PHASE 4

Intelligent

VSL builds agents, BEMEA builds custom actions
PHASE 5 · ONGOING

Empower & Scale

Copilot in SharePoint by prompt, a Centre of Excellence, citizen makers and new modules, with BEMEA on SLA for specialist needs.

Roadmap at a glance · indicative

Live in about 11 weeks. Each release then gets room to settle before the next phase starts.

Discovery takes 2 weeks and Phase 1 takes 8–9 weeks. Every go-live is followed by hypercare and a settling-in period before the next phase starts. Copilot quick wins come after Phase 3 secures access. The full roadmap runs about 13 months, and scope and timing are confirmed at each phase gate.

0Phase 0 · Mobilise & Discover · 2 weeks

Get the foundations and decisions right before building anything.

🔎Discovery

  • Profile the database: 69,548 correspondences, 39,359 LPRs, job files and contacts
  • Map the 300–400 GB shared-drive folder structure, file types, long paths and duplicates
  • Catalogue numbering rules for each project and type, including historical exceptions
  • Baseline today's cycle times so improvements can be measured

🧪Two-site approach

  • BEMEA works with user-level access only, so head office IT creates two SharePoint sites and makes BEMEA the site owner
  • DCS-Test is used for building and UAT. DCS (Production) is the live system.
  • The Power Apps solution reads its site address from environment variables, so promoting to Production repoints it with no rebuild
  • Only standard connectors in Phase 1, so no premium licence is needed

🤝Decisions to close

  • Access model, agreed with head office in France, which administers SharePoint
  • Whether data stays in SharePoint lists or moves to Dataverse later, as volumes grow
  • How long the legacy intranet stays read-only after go-live
  • Product owner, document-control champion and the site owners
Exit criteria
Signed scope and backlogTest & Prod sites provisionedMigration approach agreedAccess matrix v1Baseline KPIs capturedCopilot oversharing scan of existing sites
Phase 005
1Phase 1 · Replace & remove manual work · 8–9 weeks

Same modules people know, with the manual handling taken out.

A like-for-like replacement, so adoption is easy. The difference is that record, number, folder and file are created as one controlled transaction.

✉️ Correspondence

  • Incoming and outgoing register
  • Automatic number for each project and type
  • Upload, rename and file in one step
  • Contact pickers and response due dates

🛒 Procurement

  • Procurement request → LPR → quotations
  • PO linked to its SAP PO number
  • Partial and full delivery notes
  • LPR printed in the existing format

🗂️ Projects & job files

  • Project codes controlled by finance
  • Project folders provisioned automatically
  • Controlled job-file records with status
  • Document registry and search

👥 Contacts & approvals

  • Governed contact master list
  • Single approval queue in the app
  • Dashboard with KPIs and quick actions
  • Works in a browser, in Teams and on mobile
Migration

The registers are imported by script with their original numbers kept. Files go across in waves by project, active projects first, and their metadata is mapped to columns. Historical projects stay searchable.

Retired

The unused homepage, the QSC module and the VPN dependency for document control are retired. The PHP intranet stays read-only for an agreed period, then is decommissioned.

Copilot-ready, switched on later

Files and metadata are now structured in SharePoint, so the content is ready for Copilot. We switch Copilot on for the DCS in Phase 4, after Phase 3 has put the access model in place.

Phase 1 · followed by 4 weeks of hypercare, a settling-in period and a 90-day warranty before Phase 2 starts06

1Phase 1 · High-level scope

What's in Phase 1, and what's not.

9 weeksSharePoint Online + Power AutomateSingle-level approvals
✓ In scope17 items
  • Requirement analysis and overall solution design.
  • SharePoint Online-based Document and Correspondence Management System (DCMS).
  • Dashboard with KPI cards, charts, quick actions and recent activities.
  • Project and Job File creation, editing and viewing.
  • Contact management.
  • Correspondence creation, tracking and management.
  • Approval management, including pending approvals, approve/reject actions and approval history.
  • Procurement request management, including LPR, quotations, purchase orders and delivery tracking.
  • Central Document Registry with document listing, search, filtering, details, preview and download.
  • SharePoint lists and data structure configuration.
  • Power Automate workflows and notifications for Job Files, Correspondence, Projects and Procurement Requests.
  • Testing, test cases and technical solution review.
  • UAT environment preparation and support for user validation.
  • Quality assurance and solution stabilization.
  • Production environment configuration and deployment.
  • Production validation and smoke testing.
  • Go-live, handover and 2 weeks of go-live support.
✕ Out of scope7 items
  • SAP integration. Quotations, Purchase Orders and Delivery Notes generated from SAP will need to be uploaded manually.
  • AI or Microsoft Copilot integration.
  • Complex third-party integrations or additional custom development outside the defined scope.
  • Multi-level or complex approval workflows beyond the agreed single-level approval process.
  • BRD, HLD as the current estimate has zero effort allocated for process documentation.
  • Dedicated Project Management effort, which is currently estimated at zero hours.
  • Any requirements beyond the agreed forms, screens and views will require effort reassessment/change control.
Phase 1 scope as agreed · anything outside it is handled through change control00

Key assumptions
  • SharePoint Online will be used as the primary platform for the portal, document management and data storage.
  • Power Automate will be used for workflow automation and notifications.
  • Customer will provide the required fields, templates, existing documents, master data and business process details.
  • Customer will provide document formats and numbering conventions.
  • Customer will provide approver names and relevant details during the development phase.
  • Single-level approval is considered for Job Files, Correspondence, Procurement Requests and Projects.
  • One LPR is assumed for each Procurement Request.
  • Customer will provide the required LPR format/template.
Indicative plan in weeks from project start · 2 weeks of go-live support follow W900
1Phase 1 · Architecture and release path

One interface, SharePoint behind it, and a controlled path from Test to Production.

Release path with user-level access
Engineered for 100k+ records
  • Indexed columns and delegable queries keep 69k+ correspondence rows fast, staying clear of the 5,000-item view threshold
  • A sequence list with optimistic locking means two users never get the same number
  • Long paths and illegal characters are fixed during migration
  • Dataverse stays an option if volumes or relationships outgrow lists
Standard connectors only in Phase 1, all covered by existing licences10

4Phase 4 · Intelligent workspace · Copilot & agents · ~12 weeks

Ask the registry instead of searching it. Agents do the routine work, and people decide.

Document Control agent · Microsoft 365 CopilotIllustrative · actual UI may differ

🗂️ Department agents

No-code agents scoped to each site's libraries, such as Correspondence, Procurement and Engineering. They are built by VSL site owners in Agent Builder.

SharePoint agentsAgent Builder

📨 Autonomous intake

An agent watches the document-control mailbox. It classifies and extracts each item and proposes the register entry, and the controller approves it with one click.

Copilot StudioAgent flows

✍️ Draft the reply

Copilot drafts responses to client and consultant letters using the thread history and VSL's standard clauses, then files the outgoing letter with a number.

Copilot in Word & Outlook

🔬 Tender & technical research

The Researcher agent pulls method statements, lessons learned and past pricing logic from closed projects to speed up bids for post-tensioning, stay cables and repair work.

ResearcherAnalyst

📓 Project notebooks

Copilot Notebooks gather a project's letters, minutes and reports for close-out and handover, and Copilot Pages turn the result into a shareable summary.

Copilot NotebooksCopilot Pages

📱 Agents in the app

Copilot Studio agents run actions in the Power App, for example "raise a PR for 40 anchor heads on URS402", with a human confirming each one.

Copilot StudioPower Apps

Feature names reflect Microsoft's state on 16 Nov 2026, and Ignite (17–20 Nov 2026) announcements will be folded in before Phase 4 design. Copilot in SharePoint's build-by-prompt features are covered in Phase 5.

      Risks and dependencies

      What could slow us down, and how we keep it in check.

      Risk
      Mitigation
      Level
      Tenant admin sits with head office in France. BEMEA has user-level access only.
      Agree the two sites, the access model and the Phase 3 admin tasks in Phase 0. Set up a joint governance board.
      High
      Migration fidelity for 300–400 GB of files, legacy names and long paths
      Profile in Phase 0, run a pilot project, migrate in waves with reconciliation reports and keep the legacy system read-only.
      Medium
      Scale: 69k+ and 39k+ record lists in SharePoint
      Indexed columns, delegable queries and archive views. Dataverse remains the escape route.
      Medium
      Copilot oversharing of existing content once more is in SharePoint
      Run an oversharing scan in Phase 0, apply Restricted Content Discovery where needed, then full segmentation in Phase 3.
      Medium
      Adoption: a 17-year habit of the old system
      Like-for-like screens, champions, role-based training, and the old system kept read-only.
      Low
      Licensing surprises from premium or metered features
      Licensing check in Phase 0, standard connectors in Phase 1, and cost shown before any Phase 2 or 4 item is approved.
      Low
      Reviewed at every phase gate18
      Measures of success

      Each phase is judged on outcomes management can see.

      PHASE 1

      Manual filing steps per correspondence

      From 4 manual steps to none. Every record has its file linked at creation.

      PHASE 1

      Records live at creation

      No greyed-out entries. Target: all new records live and searchable straight away.

      PHASE 2

      PR → PO cycle time

      Baselined in Phase 0, tracked weekly in Power BI after approvals move into Teams and Outlook.

      PHASE 2

      Overdue correspondence responses

      Visible by project and consultant, with automatic reminders before the due date.

      PHASE 3

      Sites with an owner, label and review

      Every department site has a named owner, a sensitivity label and a quarterly access review.

      PHASE 4–5

      Solutions built in-house

      The share of new requests delivered by VSL ME makers rather than BEMEA, alongside active Copilot and agent users.

      The bars show direction of travel, not committed targets. Baselines are captured in Phase 0.19
      Decisions requested from VSL ME management

      Five decisions to start small and start now.

      01

      Approve Phases 0 and 1

      Commit to the replacement scope. Phases 2–5 are approved one gate at a time.

      02

      Name the owners

      A product owner, a document-control champion and site owners for training.

      03

      Engage head office IT

      Create the Test and Prod sites, grant BEMEA site-owner access, agree the access model and, for Phase 2, deploy the Outlook add-in.

      04

      Confirm licensing

      Copilot coverage across users, and any premium licensing needs.

      05

      Choose the support model

      The SLA level that starts after the 90-day warranty.
